note: Clementine's actions no longer commit the swap: while Tobias makes tea she never goes near the shelf, yet she later carries the real stick in her cape.

patch.value: When Tobias went to the tea nook to make her tea, she swapped the real stick for the fake. She wrapped the real stick in the thick hanky, so its glow and hum could not be seen or heard, and hid it in her cape's deep secret pocket.
When Tobias went to the tea nook to make her tea, she looked at the treasures from across the room and never went near the shelf.
